scientific_question: Using identical held-out points, how does the native four-parameter arctangent model compare with the frozen cubic/cubic rational candidate and frozen cubic polynomial baseline on NIST Roszman1?

native_rule.singular_rule: An exact x=b4 prediction is undefined and must be recorded as non-finite; do not replace it by a limit or certified full-data fit
native_rule.optimizer: scipy.optimize.curve_fit method=lm, maxfev=200000, full_output=true; run both frozen starts and select the lowest finite training RSS
native_rule.failure_rule: Retain every failed start, non-finite RSS, non-finite prediction and failed fold; no post-hoc start, bounds, scaling or fold changes
native_rule.retuning: No model, start, optimizer, fold or threshold changes after seeing outcomes

known_answer_rule.purpose: Fit all 25 observations only to verify the native equation and optimizer against the published NIST known answer; never use this fit as holdout evidence

fold_rule.construction: Reuse exactly the frozen rational-candidate test points; fit native parameters only on the other four groups

comparison_rule.join: Match native and rational predictions by fold and exact x; require observed y to match exactly
comparison_rule.rational_metrics: Reuse the frozen rational-candidate fold metrics and snapshot predictions without refitting
comparison_rule.cubic_baseline_metrics: Reuse the frozen cubic-baseline fold metrics without refitting; per-point baseline predictions are not available in the frozen result
comparison_rule.metrics: Recompute native RMSE, MAE and maximum absolute residual from the five held-out predictions in each fold
comparison_rule.fold_winners: Compare native RMSE with rational and cubic-baseline RMSE separately; preserve wins, losses, ties and failed fits without a single scalar ranking
comparison_rule.pooled_metrics: Compute native and rational RMSE, MAE and maximum absolute residual over all 25 held-out predictions only when every fold succeeds; do not fabricate pooled cubic-baseline metrics
comparison_rule.bound_separation: Do not transfer rational denominator, ellipsoid, box, residual-bound or continuous-safety claims to the native arctangent model

prohibitions: No use of the certified full-data fit as a held-out prediction
No transfer of rational-model proof regions or residual bounds to the native model
No hiding of optimizer failures, non-finite predictions or fold-level losses
No probability, confidence, physical-endogeneity or independent-experiment claim
No post-hoc start, fold, scaling or model changes after seeing results
